summary: Full end-to-end test of HireLens (Expo web preview + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass against the public URL (health, demo login, signup/login, overview metrics=1 job/18 candidates, rankings sorted desc with expected top-3 Maya Chen 74.2 / Leo Martin 67.97 / Arjun Mehta 66.85, score decomposition integrity, run-twice determinism identical, candidate detail, technical analysis 8 stages + 35/35/20/10 weights, insights, recruiter-ai grounded answers, jobs CRUD, 400/401/404 error handling). Frontend: all requested flows verified via Playwright on mobile viewport — demo login, 4 tabs with green active highlight, overview metrics, analyze->rankings (top-3 podium + 18 rows), candidate detail (score circle, 4 breakdown bars, penalty, evidence, claimed-vs-demonstrated, 10 match rows, critical gaps card on rank-18 candidate), compare screen with working A/B chips + LLM-grounded explanation card, technical view (8-stage pipeline, weight rows, 4 telemetry cards), insights (2 cards + student module card), Recruiter AI (suggestion chips + chat input/send both return grounded answer cards — LLM responded live), sign out via avatar returns to auth and session is cleared (persists after reload). Fixed one testID bug in compare.tsx (B-row chips had A-row testIDs because 'CANDIDATE B'.includes('A') is true). No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Any missing/invalid/expired Authorization header silently falls back to the demo user (server.py:74-85) — endpoints are effectively unauthenticated. Acceptable for a demo build but must not ship to production.
No DELETE /api/jobs endpoint; test-created jobs can only be removed directly from MongoDB.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: B-row chips rendered testID 'compare-chip-a-*' because label.includes('A') matches 'CANDIDATE B'. Added explicit side prop.

integration_issues.issue: useActiveJob() picks jobs[0] (newest by created_at). Any newly created job hijacks the entire pipeline (Overview/Jobs/Rankings/AI/Compare all switch to the new job with 0 candidates). Discovered when a backend test-created job made Rankings show '0 candidates'. Not a bug for the single-demo-job scope but fragile.

issues: Tab bar labels are 10px — below ideal 11-12px minimum for readability, though contrast and 64px bar height are fine

action_items: Consider pinning the active pipeline to the demo job (or explicit job selection) instead of 'newest job wins' in useActiveJob
Remove the silent demo-user fallback in current_user before any non-demo release
Add DELETE /api/jobs (or a test-cleanup endpoint) to allow cleanup without direct DB access
Optional: bump tab label fontSize from 10 to 11
critical_code_review_comments: server.py current_user silently degrades to demo user on any auth failure — masks real auth bugs (security note)
ranking_engine weights and score decomposition verified: components sum minus critical_penalty == final_score (asserted in tests)
Frontend correctly uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from .env, StyleSheet.create throughout, Text wrapping correct, testIDs on all interactive elements
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch absent); safe-area handled via useSafeAreaInsets
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed signup users and one TEST_Integration Role job during the run; cleaned up directly from MongoDB (2 TEST jobs, 2 TEST users removed). Demo dataset (1 job, 18 candidates) untouched and re-verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: compare.tsx chip testIDs are now compare-chip-a-*/compare-chip-b-* (fixed). Sign-out avatar: use scoped selector '[data-testid="overview-screen"] [data-testid="header-avatar-button"]' — multiple tab screens stay mounted in DOM. Expo web preview needs ~30-40s initial bundle wait after restart. If backend tests run, they create TEST_ jobs which hijack useActiveJob (newest-first) — clean up via mongosh test_database db.jobs.deleteMany({job_id: {$ne: 'job-demo-backend-platform'}}). LLM (gpt-5.4 via Emergent key) responded live during this run; deterministic fallback also verified present in code.
rca_of_issue: Bug: Compare screen candidate-B chips unreachable by testID. Root cause: compare.tsx ChipRow derived testID via label.includes('A'); 'CANDIDATE B'.includes('A') === true so both rows emitted compare-chip-a-*. Fix: explicit side='a'|'b' prop. Verified 18/18 chips per row and B=rank-3 selection updates the VS hero.
